prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed cinematic digital illustration titled “Creative Universe — Cozy AI Creator Room,” showing Rahma Saleh as a stylish young female AI content creator in a warm, magical, cozy studio filled with fairy lights, books, plants, creative tools, and motivational notes.

Canvas: Vertical portrait composition, rich warm amber lighting, dense cozy maximalist room, cinematic depth of field, polished semi-realistic digital art, sharp facial details, glowing bokeh, inviting creator-workspace atmosphere.

Main subject: In the center, show one large main woman seated comfortably in a plush beige armchair. She has long wavy brown hair, light-medium skin, glossy lips, and oversized tinted glasses. She wears a soft yellow oversized hoodie, black leggings, white chunky sneakers, a smartwatch, rings, and delicate jewelry. She sits cross-legged, holding a black mug labeled “FOCUS CREATE INSPIRE” with a small heart, looking confident and relaxed.

Layout and counted character vignettes: Include exactly 10 visible versions of the same creator in the room: 1 central seated main creator; 2 left upper mini creator sitting on a shelf; 3 top center mini creator playing a ukulele; 4 upper right mini creator working on a laptop; 5 left middle mini creator writing on a clipboard; 6 left lower mini creator holding a camera; 7 lower left mini creator taking a selfie near a vintage camera; 8 bottom center mini creator sleeping on a white fluffy dog with “Zzz”; 9 right middle mini creator hugging a golden puppy; 10 lower right mini creator reading a book beside motivational signs.

Visible signs and text: Add a glowing blackboard on the upper left reading “MY CREATIVE UNIVERSE” with a small heart. Add one hanging checklist board on the left with exactly 6 heart-bullet items: “Create,” “Edit,” “Design,” “Plan,” “Dream,” “Repeat.” Add one hanging board on the upper right titled “TODAY’S CREATIVE MENU” with exactly 6 checked items: “Content Creation,” “AI Prompts,” “Creative Ideas,” “Storytelling,” “Motivation,” “Coffee Break,” plus a heart. Add a small black desk sign near the laptop reading “DREAM PLAN DO REPEAT.” Add a right-side encouragement sign reading “KEEP GOING YOU’VE GOT THIS” with a heart. Add an open spiral notebook at the bottom titled “MY DAILY PLAN” with exactly 5 checkbox items: “Work on ideas,” “Create content,” “Learn new things,” “Spend time with my loved ones,” “Stay happy.” Add one yellow sticky note reading “Every day is a new chance to be better” with a heart. Add a small signature at the bottom reading Rahma Saleh with a heart.

Props and counted objects: Include exactly 2 dogs, one small white fluffy dog sleeping at the bottom center and one golden puppy held on the right. Include exactly 2 cameras, one vintage camera on stacked books at the lower left and one handheld camera used by the mini creator. Include 1 laptop, 1 tablet showing a photo grid, 1 black mug, 1 ukulele, 1 open book, 1 clipboard, 1 smartphone, 1 lit candle, 1 pen cup full of colorful pens, and several small potted plants. At the lower left, include a stack of exactly 5 books with visible spine titles: “CREATIVE SOUL,” “DIGITAL CONTENT,” “AI INNOVATION,” “SELF LOVE,” “SUCCESS.”

Environment: The background is a cozy creator studio with wooden shelves, books, coffee cups, greenery, hanging string lights, a city-view window at night on the right, warm reflections, and soft golden ambience. Make the scene feel like a miniature creative universe surrounding the main creator.

Style constraints: Beautiful polished AI illustration, hyper-detailed, warm golden color grade, cute cozy aesthetic, cinematic fantasy-realism, no harsh shadows, no clutter that hides the signs, keep all listed text legible, preserve the exact counts of character versions and major props. Use AI content creation as the overall theme.
